titles.native: 崩坏：星穹铁道 花火把戏

description:
This world's just like a big non-stop circus showcasing beasts brawling all day and night: bears on unicycles, lions leaping through fire hoops, monkeys juggling bowls... Me, I'm happy being a side character in the background, cheering on those who have the limelight. Then, at the climax of the performance... bang! Sparkling like fireworks into brilliant colors—

You think the leading character would dare do this?

(Source: Honkai Star Rail YouTube Channel)
